  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Demos, traces, systems, and scars carry more weight than predictions.

Belief

#### Practitioners, not spectators.

The future of AI is built by people close enough to the work to show it.

Room Rule

#### Demos over decks.

If it matters, bring the thing and show how it behaves.

> Like the Homebrew Computer Club, AI Tinkerers is built around small rooms where practitioners
> compare notes before the path is obvious.

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## Why we exist (our story)

We started this 8 years ago as builders who make apps for fun and test the newest models before they
ship. Aloa is the extension of that love: we build for ourselves and for others.

[Speak to Someone on Our Team →][59]

Resources

## Sharing what we're learning

AI is moving fast. We're learning every week, and we want to share what we're discovering so other
teams can build responsibly and push their industries forward.

### A guide to HIPAA-compliant AI

Practical steps for building healthcare AI with privacy, security, and compliance baked in.

[ View resource ][60]

### Building AI agents

How to design, test, and deploy agents that automate real workflows without breaking trust.

[ View resource ][61]

### Lessons on crafting beautiful apps

Hard-earned insights on design, craft, and building software people love to use.

[ Watch video ][62]

FAQ

## You have questions, we have answers

Clear, direct answers to the questions we hear from founders, clinical leaders, and operations
teams.

### What type of projects do you do?

We focus on AI projects, but we also build custom applications like internal tools, MVPs, and proofs
of concept for startups and established teams.

### Who do you partner with?

We work with private practices, startups building the MVP right, SMBs automating workflows, and
larger teams that need custom tools built correctly.

### Do you only work in healthcare?

Healthcare is a recent focus because of our HIPAA-compliant AI work, but we also build for finance,
real estate, and other regulated industries with similar compliance needs.

### What is the pricing model?

For AI projects, we typically work hourly with a cap. We can do fixed-cost projects based on budget,
but prefer hourly for AI due to variability.

### What is the team composition?

Most of our developers are in-house. For specialized needs, we bring in trusted partners. We also
have in-house designers and product managers to understand your business and execute well.

### How fast can you deliver a proof of concept?

We usually target 2 to 4 weeks. We prioritize the riskiest assumptions first, validate them quickly,
and then scale into production.

## Why we exist (our story)

We started this 8 years ago as builders who make apps for fun and test the newest models before they
ship. Aloa is the extension of that love: we build for ourselves and for others.

[Speak to Someone on Our Team →][59]

Resources

## Sharing what we're learning

AI is moving fast. We're learning every week, and we want to share what we're discovering so other
teams can build responsibly and push their industries forward.

### A guide to HIPAA-compliant AI

Practical steps for building healthcare AI with privacy, security, and compliance baked in.

How to design, test, and deploy agents that automate real workflows without breaking trust.

[ View resource ][61]

### Lessons on crafting beautiful apps

Hard-earned insights on design, craft, and building software people love to use.

[ Watch video ][62]

FAQ

## You have questions, we have answers

Clear, direct answers to the questions we hear from founders, clinical leaders, and operations
teams.

### What type of projects do you do?

We focus on AI projects, but we also build custom applications like internal tools, MVPs, and proofs
of concept for startups and established teams.

### Who do you partner with?

We work with private practices, startups building the MVP right, SMBs automating workflows, and
larger teams that need custom tools built correctly.

### Do you only work in healthcare?

Healthcare is a recent focus because of our HIPAA-compliant AI work, but we also build for finance,
real estate, and other regulated industries with similar compliance needs.

### What is the pricing model?

For AI projects, we typically work hourly with a cap. We can do fixed-cost projects based on budget,
but prefer hourly for AI due to variability.

### What is the team composition?

Most of our developers are in-house. For specialized needs, we bring in trusted partners. We also
have in-house designers and product managers to understand your business and execute well.

### How fast can you deliver a proof of concept?

We usually target 2 to 4 weeks. We prioritize the riskiest assumptions first, validate them quickly,
and then scale into production.

# Welcome to the
# HealthTech Activator

[
Learn more
][23]

## What is the HealthTech Activator?

The HealthTech Activator (HTA) is a coordinated, ecosystem-wide support mechanism for early-stage
founders and companies in NZ’s healthtech sector.

The HTA makes it easier for healthtech companies to find and access the support they need to turn
their health innovations into successful businesses. In doing so, it aims to advance, de-risk and
accelerate the commercialisation of innovation in NZ’s healthtech ecosystem.

[
Learn more
][24]

## What is the HealthTech Activator?

The HealthTech Activator (HTA) is a coordinated, ecosystem-wide support mechanism for early-stage
founders and companies in NZ’s healthtech sector.

The HTA makes it easier for healthtech companies to find and access the support they need to turn
their health innovations into successful businesses. In doing so, it aims to advance, de-risk and
accelerate the commercialisation of innovation in NZ’s healthtech ecosystem.

## Proyecto Salud Mental

En colaboración con el Consorcio Compensar, modernizamos su programa de salud mental al digitalizar
y optimizar la historia clínica de los pacientes. Este avance mejoró la calidad de los registros y
facilitó un seguimiento detallado y accesible para el equipo médico.

Integramos escalas especializadas como RQC, Fagerström y Audit para evaluar la dependencia de
nicotina y el riesgo de consumo de alcohol, brindando herramientas precisas a los profesionales.
También optimizamos el envío automatizado de documentos y educación al paciente por correo
electrónico, y mejoramos la visualización de resultados de laboratorio.

Utilizando la metodología ágil Scrum, completamos el proyecto de manera eficiente, logrando una
experiencia de usuario más fluida tanto para pacientes como para profesionales.

## Clínica Oncológica 127

sistema innovador que revolucionó la gestión de medicamentos y creó una historia clínica oncológica
personalizada. Con esta herramienta, el equipo médico ahora maneja y analiza datos de manera más
precisa, lo que permite personalizar los tratamientos de forma más efectiva.

La automatización del proceso de medicamentos, desde la prescripción hasta la administración, ha
mejorado la trazabilidad y la disminución de errores. Como resultado, la clínica ha logrado tiempos
de respuesta más rápidos, mayor seguridad para los pacientes y una atención más eficiente,
destacándose como un líder en tecnología en el campo oncológico.

## Proyecto Salud Domiciliaria

En 2016, Comfandi innovó con el Programa Cuidado Domiciliario Amiga, donde nuestro equipo lideró
este proyecto pionero al virtualizar la atención domiciliaria en SAP, permitiendo a más de 500
pacientes recibir cuidados en casa. La integración digital de historias clínicas, prescripciones y
terapias facilitó la gestión remota y redujo costos operativos al eliminar traslados innecesarios.

El impacto fue significativo: la inversión se recuperó en solo seis meses, mejorando la calidad de
vida de los pacientes y consolidando a Comfandi como líder en atención domiciliaria en el valle del
cauca.

experiencia de usuario más fluida tanto para pacientes como para profesionales.

[Clínica Oncológica 127 ]
Colsubsidio

## Clínica Oncológica 127

La Clínica Oncológica 127 transformó su forma de tratar a los pacientes al adoptar SAP-ISH, un
sistema innovador que revolucionó la gestión de medicamentos y creó una historia clínica oncológica
personalizada. Con esta herramienta, el equipo médico ahora maneja y analiza datos de manera más
precisa, lo que permite personalizar los tratamientos de forma más efectiva.

La automatización del proceso de medicamentos, desde la prescripción hasta la administración, ha
mejorado la trazabilidad y la disminución de errores. Como resultado, la clínica ha logrado tiempos
de respuesta más rápidos, mayor seguridad para los pacientes y una atención más eficiente,
destacándose como un líder en tecnología en el campo oncológico.

[Proyecto Salud Domiciliaria]
Comfandi

## Proyecto Salud Domiciliaria

En 2016, Comfandi innovó con el Programa Cuidado Domiciliario Amiga, donde nuestro equipo lideró
este proyecto pionero al virtualizar la atención domiciliaria en SAP, permitiendo a más de 500
pacientes recibir cuidados en casa. La integración digital de historias clínicas, prescripciones y
terapias facilitó la gestión remota y redujo costos operativos al eliminar traslados innecesarios.

El impacto fue significativo: la inversión se recuperó en solo seis meses, mejorando la calidad de
vida de los pacientes y consolidando a Comfandi como líder en atención domiciliaria en el valle del
cauca.

crecimiento.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

## The Hidden Risks in the Tech Race

AI and emerging tech are evolving fast and staying behind means losing your edge. At the same time,
rushing is where most mistakes happen, isn’t it? Below are some of the essential factors worth
considering before innovation creates more risk than value.
* ### Security
  
  From AI prompt injections to data leakage, technology is naturally risk-prone.
  
  We build custom tech solutions with security in mind from day one, using reproducible methods,
  locally hosted LLMs, robust cloud practices, and proven cybersecurity partnerships when needed.
* ### Applicability
  
  Even the most intelligent systems fail when they chase hype instead of real needs.
  
  As your advisory partner, we help you build tech solutions, including custom artificial
  intelligence software, to simplify things, not add friction. With our training programs, you can
  equip your people with necessary skills to truly adopt and scale your AI and digital
  transformation initiatives.
* ## Future Readiness
  
  Shifting regulations and market realities make future-proofing vital.
  
  We bring the kind of adaptability and resilience that only come from real-world experience. That’s
  why you can rely on the continuity-driven approach to tech development, helping you stay ready for
  whatever comes next.

### This is Celestica

At Celestica, we engineer the technologies that shape what’s next. We partner with leading brands to
solve their toughest challenges – and together accelerate market advancements.

[What we do 2026]

### What we do

Celestica is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With
deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions, Celestica
enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances
technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica
helps its customers achieve a competitive advantage.

[ Learn more ][67]

### Expertise Across Industries

Technology is driving advancements that are revolutionizing the way we live and work. Our end-to-end
product lifecycle solutions support the most complex products across multiple markets, including
communications, enterprise, aerospace and defense, smart energy, healthcare technology, industrial
and capital equipment.
[ View our markets][68]

deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions, Celestica
enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances
technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica
helps its customers achieve a competitive advantage.

product lifecycle solutions support the most complex products across multiple markets, including
communications, enterprise, aerospace and defense, smart energy, healthcare technology, industrial
and capital equipment.

## HOME HEALTHCARE

## REVOLUTIONISING

[Become a carer ][18]
[Get in touch ][19]

## Revolutionising healthcare – taking it from hospital to home

Cera is Europe's largest provider of digital-first home healthcare. We are redefining healthcare by
moving more and more services out of hospitals and into people's own homes.

[SofiaYangMartinezPhotography-26.jpg]

## Cera is leading the use of AI to predict health risks, cutting hospitalisations by more than half

Our carers and nurses deliver a visit every second on average, using‎ Cera's technology to keep
people safe and well in their‎ own homes. 

## Our technology reduces service user falls by 20% – the leading cause of hospitalisations in older
## people

Cera is transforming health outcomes on a historic scale while easing pressures on public services –
saving £1 billion to date for the UK Government & NHS and contributing £1.5 million in daily
savings.

[SofiaYangMartinezPhotography-253.jpg]

## We are using AI to transform staffing in care – attracting 1 million frontline applicants in 2
## years

We are growing the care talent pool – using AI to revolutionise recruitment, training, retention and
productivity, and making care more of a career through our industry-leading Career Pathways.

## We are boosting the economy by creating thousands of jobs in care

Our nationwide Back to Work programme is creating thousands of jobs for the long-term unemployed,
with 34% of recent Cera recruits previously unemployed, 16% joining us from longer-term economic
inactivity, and double the industry average living with a disability.

[Mark Allen COOPER00001.jpg]

## Our model is 15 times more carbon-friendly than hospital care

We are reducing the environmental impact of care by embedding carbon-efficiency into our operations
and reducing avoidable hospital admissions – contributing to a greener healthcare future.

## Cera is innovating to take care into the future

Cera has scaled 100x in five years, growing our annualised revenues from $5m to $500 million, and we
are pioneering the use of innovative technologies including AI Care Robots to lead the sector into
the future.

# Clang: a C language family frontend for LLVM

The Clang project provides a language front-end and tooling infrastructure for languages in the C
language family (C, C++, Objective C/C++, OpenCL, and CUDA) for the [LLVM][26] project. Both a
GCC-compatible compiler driver (clang) and an MSVC-compatible compiler driver (clang-cl.exe) are
provided. You can [get and build][27] the source today.

## Features and Goals

Some of the goals for the project include the following:

**[End-User Features][28]**:
* Fast compiles and low memory use
* Expressive diagnostics ([examples][29])
* GCC & MSVC compatibility

**[Utility and Applications][30]**:
* Modular library based architecture
* Support diverse clients (refactoring, static analysis, code generation, etc.)
* Allow tight integration with IDEs
* Use the LLVM 'Apache 2' [License][31]

**[Internal Design and Implementation][32]**:
* A real-world, production quality compiler
* A simple and hackable code base
* A single unified parser for C, Objective C, C++, and Objective C++
* Conformance with C/C++/ObjC and their variants

Of course this is only a rough outline of the goals and features of Clang. To get a true sense of
what it is all about, see the [Features][33] section, which breaks each of these down and explains
them in more detail.

## Why?

Development of the new front-end was started out of a need for a compiler that allows better
diagnostics, better integration with IDEs, a license that is compatible with commercial products,
and a nimble compiler that is easy to develop and maintain. All of these were motivations for
starting work on a new front-end that could meet these needs.

## Current Status

Clang is considered to be a production quality C, Objective-C, C++ and Objective-C++ compiler when
targeting any target supported by LLVM. As example, Clang is used in production to build
performance-critical software like Chrome or Firefox.
If you are looking for source analysis or source-to-source transformation tools, Clang is probably a
great solution for you. Please see the [C++ status][34] page or the [C status][35] page for more
information about what standard modes and features are supported.

## Get it and get involved!

Start by [getting the code, building it, and playing with it][36]. This will show you the sorts of
things we can do today and will let you have the "Clang experience" first hand: hopefully it will
"resonate" with you. :)

Once you've done that, please consider [getting involved in the Clang community][37]. The Clang
developers include numerous volunteer contributors with a variety of backgrounds. If you're
interested in following the development of Clang, signing up for a mailing list is a good way to
learn about how the project works.

Who can open a Cheq tourist wallet?

Citizens of G20 nations and Non-resident Indian citizens are allowed to open a Cheq tourist wallet.

* Free Annual Wellness Exam

Ola Strokirk, Founder & CEO

# Custom software development
# for startups and companies

### We focus on developing
### solutions for:

### STARTUPS AND SCALE-UPS

We deliver products and solutions to help startups focus on the essential things: finding the proper
product-market fit and scaling their business. We craft software products that have the power to
attract customers, be successfully presented to investors, and are ready for scaling.

### MIDSIZE BUSINESSES

We get deeply involved in our clients’ business processes and only use advanced technologies to
build unique solutions that help healthcare, AgeTech, real estate, logistics, and other companies
operate more efficiently.

### Industries that benefit
### from our IT solutions

Our IT products span multiple industries. Here are the four sectors of our expertise.

### Healthcare

Our experience includes custom software development for healthtech startups and healthcare
facilities. We built products for seniors, a staffing platform for healthcare workers, mHealth apps,
and patient engagement platforms. Demigos’ portfolio covers easily scalable, secure solutions that
are compliant with HIPAA and GDPR.

[Learn More][21]

### Age Tech

The Demigos team knows the problems and challenges faced by senior living communities, in-home care
businesses, and individual caregivers. Our scalable and flexible custom software solutions help
streamline operations, payments, and scheduling, ensuring exceptional customer service.
We design and build neat, easy-to-use web and mobile apps catering to the needs of senior living
facilities, senior people, and giving their family members peace of mind.

[Learn More][22]

### Real estate

We built several platforms, including a real estate investment analyzer and a unique auction system
for purchasing real estate. Working with MLS, integration with DocuSign, instant recalculation of
large data sets for amortization—we’ve got them and much more under our belt.

### Logistics

Our software engineers built a series of mobile-driven Uber-like platforms providing logistics
operators with access to the driver labor pool. Additionally, we designed and coded custom ERP
solutions for a coaching bus company in Canada.

### OUR PROJECTS

### Corporate Wellness Platform

A mobile app for employees and a web dashboard for employers

The mobile app we built for the client lets employees track their health vitals, either by entering
them manually or through integrated wearables. Meanwhile, employers can see aggregated, anonymized
data on team well-being on the dashboard, which helps them improve wellness programs.

[READ MORE][23]

### MSHFA Telemedicine Platform

A telemedicine and EMR solution for a Kuwaiti clinic

MSHFA is a telemedicine and EMR solution integrated with a pharmacy ecommerce store. It enables
video conferencing between doctors and patients, stores history of patients’ symptoms, lab tests,
diagnoses, referrals, etc, and allows to order medicine through the app.

[READ MORE][24]

### plumBid Real Estate Auction Platform

An algorithm-based auction platform

plumBid platform provides an easy and transparent process to buy and sell real estate which results
in the best price and terms. The revolutionary and patent-pending technology removes the guesswork
and puts seller, buyer and agent in control of the entire process, maximizing the outcome for
everyone.

[READ MORE][25]

### Third-Party Administrator Platform

A robust web platform for a licensed US-based TPA company

The platform automates processes for a third-party benefits administration service. It provides
client companies "Best-in-Breed" core, ancillary, supplemental, and voluntary benefit & insurance
products, plans, programs, & services at the lowest possible costs from insurance carriers
throughout the country.

[READ MORE][26]

### GapNurse

Healthcare matchmaking platform for nurses

GapNurse is a healthcare matchmaking platform that seamlessly connects healthcare workers with
organizations that value their skills and knowledge. We built a mobile application for nurses, a web
platform for facility managers, and an administrators' platform.

automate major manual processes that streamline efficiency of applications.

[READ MORE][28]

ERP system for bus company in Canada

ERP system for bus company in Canada. Universal Coach Line provides quality bus charters to all

### Ofinta

Order and delivery system for e-commerce

Ofinta is an e-commerce platform for the East African region that provides payment integration with

[READ MORE][34]

### Mobilism

Mobile marketplace for popular forum in the US

Mobilism is a large US website for sharing books, games and apps with 94,000 + unique users per day.
We have designed and build an Android app and API for an app & website integration, which provides
the ability for users to access the forum with Android app in a convenient way.

[READ MORE][35]

### Why Demigos?

We create custom solutions for startups
that clients love. Here’s how:

Laser focus on value
We know how important it is to build IT solutions that bring measurable value to your startup or
company. We begin by asking the right questions, analyzing, and figuring out what solutions will
have the most significant impact on your business.
Flexibility
Flexibility is our top priority when developing software solutions. Requirements can change
mid-flight, and we’re ready to optimize and accommodate even last-minute changes. This is a major
advantage of custom software development for your startup or company over off-the-shelf solutions.
Scalability
Some solutions are expected to be successful, while the success of others leaves their creators
surprised. But in both scenarios, scalability is critical. The architecture of our software
solutions is designed to scale to one million daily active users and even more.
Design
When users love a product, they’re eager to recommend it. In that case, the design is just as
important for us as product functionality. We know how to build IT solutions for startups that are
robust, beautiful, easy-to-use, and, most importantly, loved by users.
Security
Data security is essential, especially in healthcare or financial services. As a software provider,
Demigos takes the security of our solutions for startups and companies very seriously. We follow
best practices for pinpointing vulnerabilities, architectural risk analysis, penetration testing,
and examining how a system behaves under attack. Security requirements and operations are at the top
of our list.
Quality
When it comes to startup product development, we raise the bar on quality. Our testing process
covers automation, performance, and unit testing—all it takes to make sure we deliver exceptional
products.

### 4 Steps to Building Successful
### IT Solutions for Your Business

Analyzing business needs and goals
Tasked with developing custom software development for startups and established companies, we start
by identifying the client’s business objectives. We’ll work together with you to understand your
pain points and how our IT solutions can help.
Developing a product vision and roadmap
We create a compelling product vision and a clear roadmap after detailed business analysis and
product prototyping.
Building the product
At Demigos, we strongly believe custom software development is most successful when it’s agile. That
is why we work according to the Scrum methodology and deliver results once every two weeks.
Getting feedback and optimizing
We always listen to the feedback our clients and their customers provide to fine-tune the product
and help it match your business goals.

### Services we offer

We focus on building products. We integrate solutions into your business processes that can bring
the greatest value for your business. Here is how we implement the process:

# Custom software development

### We focus on developing
### solutions for:

### STARTUPS AND SCALE-UPS

We deliver products and solutions to help startups focus on the essential things: finding the proper
product-market fit and scaling their business. We craft software products that have the power to
attract customers, be successfully presented to investors, and are ready for scaling.

### MIDSIZE BUSINESSES

We get deeply involved in our clients’ business processes and only use advanced technologies to
build unique solutions that help healthcare, AgeTech, real estate, logistics, and other companies
operate more efficiently.

### Industries that benefit
### from our IT solutions

Our IT products span multiple industries. Here are the four sectors of our expertise.

### Healthcare

Our experience includes custom software development for healthtech startups and healthcare
facilities. We built products for seniors, a staffing platform for healthcare workers, mHealth apps,
and patient engagement platforms. Demigos’ portfolio covers easily scalable, secure solutions that
are compliant with HIPAA and GDPR.

[Learn More][21]

### Age Tech

The Demigos team knows the problems and challenges faced by senior living communities, in-home care
businesses, and individual caregivers. Our scalable and flexible custom software solutions help
streamline operations, payments, and scheduling, ensuring exceptional customer service.
We design and build neat, easy-to-use web and mobile apps catering to the needs of senior living
facilities, senior people, and giving their family members peace of mind.

[Learn More][22]

### Real estate

We built several platforms, including a real estate investment analyzer and a unique auction system
for purchasing real estate. Working with MLS, integration with DocuSign, instant recalculation of
large data sets for amortization—we’ve got them and much more under our belt.

### Logistics

Our software engineers built a series of mobile-driven Uber-like platforms providing logistics
operators with access to the driver labor pool. Additionally, we designed and coded custom ERP
solutions for a coaching bus company in Canada.

### OUR PROJECTS

### Corporate Wellness Platform

A mobile app for employees and a web dashboard for employers

The mobile app we built for the client lets employees track their health vitals, either by entering
them manually or through integrated wearables. Meanwhile, employers can see aggregated, anonymized
data on team well-being on the dashboard, which helps them improve wellness programs.

[READ MORE][23]

### MSHFA Telemedicine Platform

A telemedicine and EMR solution for a Kuwaiti clinic

MSHFA is a telemedicine and EMR solution integrated with a pharmacy ecommerce store. It enables
video conferencing between doctors and patients, stores history of patients’ symptoms, lab tests,
diagnoses, referrals, etc, and allows to order medicine through the app.

[READ MORE][24]

### plumBid Real Estate Auction Platform

An algorithm-based auction platform

plumBid platform provides an easy and transparent process to buy and sell real estate which results
in the best price and terms. The revolutionary and patent-pending technology removes the guesswork
and puts seller, buyer and agent in control of the entire process, maximizing the outcome for
everyone.

[READ MORE][25]

### Third-Party Administrator Platform

A robust web platform for a licensed US-based TPA company

The platform automates processes for a third-party benefits administration service. It provides
client companies "Best-in-Breed" core, ancillary, supplemental, and voluntary benefit & insurance
products, plans, programs, & services at the lowest possible costs from insurance carriers
throughout the country.

[READ MORE][26]

### GapNurse

Healthcare matchmaking platform for nurses

GapNurse is a healthcare matchmaking platform that seamlessly connects healthcare workers with
organizations that value their skills and knowledge. We built a mobile application for nurses, a web
platform for facility managers, and an administrators' platform.

[READ MORE][27]

working together on the early stages of online development for the company, including service to
automate major manual processes that streamline efficiency of applications.

[READ MORE][28]

### Aliro

Platform tailored to agro-commodity traders

Aliro is an international marketplace and trading platform for verified buyers and sellers of
agricultural products. It connects producers, brokers, distributors, wholesalers, brand name
manufacturers, and government trading houses from all over the world on a wide range of product
categories including grains, oils, spices, cereals, sugars, seeds, flour, fruits & vegetables, and
many others.

[READ MORE][29]

### YVRSkylynx

Website and analytics

We created a website to sell bus tickets online, measured UX and made improvements to design,
analysed effectiveness of different advertising channels.

[READ MORE][30]

### Successfilly

Enriching online courses

Successfilly brings online education to a new level by allowing teachers to use embedded pages in
online course services like Udemy or Teachable to greatly enrich course content and add interaction.

[READ MORE][31]

### Portl

A go-to platform for finding freelancers

Freelancers and employers alike usually hit a roadblock - how to find each other. Existing
marketplaces are more like job search website and don't offer much room for freelancers to market
their skills. And if you don't have connections to refer you to good specialists, you'll end up
spending more money than expected.

[READ MORE][32]

### UCL System

ERP system for bus company in Canada

ERP system for bus company in Canada. Universal Coach Line provides quality bus charters to all
travel destinations in North America. The company previously utilized outdated enterprise resource
planning software, which was local for all 3 divisions across Canada.

[READ MORE][33]

### Ofinta

Order and delivery system for e-commerce

Ofinta is an e-commerce platform for the East African region that provides payment integration with
MPesa, a Vodafone's wallet-based service accessed through a mobile account.

[READ MORE][34]

### Mobilism

Mobile marketplace for popular forum in the US

Mobilism is a large US website for sharing books, games and apps with 94,000 + unique users per day.
We have designed and build an Android app and API for an app & website integration, which provides
the ability for users to access the forum with Android app in a convenient way.

[READ MORE][35]

### Why Demigos?

We create custom solutions for startups
that clients love. Here’s how:

Laser focus on value
We know how important it is to build IT solutions that bring measurable value to your startup or
company. We begin by asking the right questions, analyzing, and figuring out what solutions will
have the most significant impact on your business.
Flexibility
Flexibility is our top priority when developing software solutions. Requirements can change
mid-flight, and we’re ready to optimize and accommodate even last-minute changes. This is a major
advantage of custom software development for your startup or company over off-the-shelf solutions.
Scalability
Some solutions are expected to be successful, while the success of others leaves their creators
surprised. But in both scenarios, scalability is critical. The architecture of our software
solutions is designed to scale to one million daily active users and even more.
Design
When users love a product, they’re eager to recommend it. In that case, the design is just as
important for us as product functionality. We know how to build IT solutions for startups that are
robust, beautiful, easy-to-use, and, most importantly, loved by users.
Security
Data security is essential, especially in healthcare or financial services. As a software provider,
Demigos takes the security of our solutions for startups and companies very seriously. We follow
best practices for pinpointing vulnerabilities, architectural risk analysis, penetration testing,
and examining how a system behaves under attack. Security requirements and operations are at the top
of our list.
Quality
When it comes to startup product development, we raise the bar on quality. Our testing process
covers automation, performance, and unit testing—all it takes to make sure we deliver exceptional
products.

### 4 Steps to Building Successful
### IT Solutions for Your Business

Analyzing business needs and goals
Tasked with developing custom software development for startups and established companies, we start
by identifying the client’s business objectives. We’ll work together with you to understand your
pain points and how our IT solutions can help.
Developing a product vision and roadmap
We create a compelling product vision and a clear roadmap after detailed business analysis and
product prototyping.
Building the product
At Demigos, we strongly believe custom software development is most successful when it’s agile. That
is why we work according to the Scrum methodology and deliver results once every two weeks.
Getting feedback and optimizing
We always listen to the feedback our clients and their customers provide to fine-tune the product
and help it match your business goals.

We focus on building products. We integrate solutions into your business processes that can bring
the greatest value for your business. Here is how we implement the process:

DeepTecher is Egypt’s leading national innovation competition focused on deep technology. It aims to
support researchers, scientists, and startups in transforming validated technology into viable

innovation. Aria Ventures builds startups by validating ideas, assembling teams, providing necessary
infrastructure, and supporting ventures through their early growth stages

Industrial Digitalization and IoT (Internet of Things) Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
(AI) Agritech and Food Security Biotechnology and Healthtech Advanced Materials and Nanotechnology

Connected systems transforming industry through smart sensors, real-time data, and automation.

Deeptecher’s mission is to identify, support, and accelerate validated, high-potential technological
innovations in Egypt by empowering researchers, innovators, and entrepreneurs through funding,
expert mentorship, and tailored commercialization opportunities through Aria Ventures

Aria Ventures is a venture studio focused on deep tech innovation. We build startups from the ground
up by validating ideas, assembling teams, providing technical and business infrastructure, and
supporting ventures through early growth stages. Our model combines strategic capital deployment
with hands-on involvement to bridge the gap between breakthrough research and market-ready startups.

technologies with commercial potential.

innovation directors

### DeepTecher Competition:

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

## 1. What is the DeepTecher competition?

DeepTecher is Egypt’s leading national innovation competition focused on deep technology. It aims to
support researchers, scientists, and startups in transforming validated technology into viable
business ventures. The competition seeks to bridge the gap between research and real-world
commercialization.

## 2. Who is organizing the DeepTecher competition?

The competition is founded and powered by Aria Ventures, a venture studio specializing in deep tech
innovation. Aria Ventures builds startups by validating ideas, assembling teams, providing necessary
infrastructure, and supporting ventures through their early growth stages

## 3. Who is eligible to apply for the competition?

Researchers affiliated with universities and research institutions. Innovators and technology
professionals (e.g., CTOs, R&D heads). Teams with a validated Proof of Concept (PoC), prototypes, or
pilot-tested technology. Early-stage deeptech startups

## 4. What stage should my technology or project be at to be eligible?

• Applicants should have technology that is validated. This means it should be at the stage of a
Proof of Concept (PoC), a working prototype, or have undergone pilot testing.

## 5. What are the specific technology sectors the competition focuses on?

## FAQs

How do I self-host Dittofeed?

Simply [deploy to Render][85] and follow the prompts to deploy Dittofeed. Alternatively,
check our [Self-Hosting Dittofeed docs][86] for more self-hosting options & instructions.

What is embedding and how does it work?

Dittofeed's [Embedded Components][87] are a way to embed any part of the Dittofeed dashboard within
your own SaaS application. They can be self-hosted or cloud-hosted. Building user messaging features
can take whole engineering teams a year or more to complete, not to mention the ongoing maintenance
headache. By embedding Dittofeed, you can instantly offer your customers both marketing automation
and transactional messaging features, all while saving money and engineering resources.

Is Dittofeed a low-code application?

Yes, Dittofeed is a low-code application. Engineering work is typically required to submit data to
Dittofeed, after which little to no engineering involvement is required.

Who is Dittofeed for?

Dittofeed is for organizations that need to automatically trigger messages to their users. We’ve
architected the platform for scalability, and the UI is simple enough for non-technical team
members.

What’s the difference between cloud and self-hosting?

With Dittofeed cloud we take care of hosting for you, and provide more advanced auth out of the box.

What kind of messages can I send with Dittofeed?

Messaging channels include email, sms, and webhooks, with more under active development. Send any
form of lifecycle marketing or transactional message, such as product updates, password change
alerts, newsletters, onboarding reminders, cart reminders, invoices/receipts, etc.

How do I contribute to the open-source repository?

To get involved in our development process, visit our [documentation][88] on contributing and [view
open issues][89].

How much does Dittofeed cost?

Self-hosting is free! Our cloud offering starts at $75/month. However, pricing is dependent on your
organization’s unique active user count and the number of events we will be processing on your
behalf. Contact support@dittofeed.com for a quote.

Is there a free trial available?

Yes, all new cloud accounts receive a free 14-day trial.

## FAQs

How do I self-host Dittofeed?

Simply [deploy to Render][85] and follow the prompts to deploy Dittofeed. Alternatively,
check our [Self-Hosting Dittofeed docs][86] for more self-hosting options & instructions.

What is embedding and how does it work?

Dittofeed's [Embedded Components][87] are a way to embed any part of the Dittofeed dashboard within
your own SaaS application. They can be self-hosted or cloud-hosted. Building user messaging features
can take whole engineering teams a year or more to complete, not to mention the ongoing maintenance
headache. By embedding Dittofeed, you can instantly offer your customers both marketing automation
and transactional messaging features, all while saving money and engineering resources.

Is Dittofeed a low-code application?

Yes, Dittofeed is a low-code application. Engineering work is typically required to submit data to
Dittofeed, after which little to no engineering involvement is required.

Who is Dittofeed for?

Dittofeed is for organizations that need to automatically trigger messages to their users. We’ve
architected the platform for scalability, and the UI is simple enough for non-technical team
members.

What’s the difference between cloud and self-hosting?

With Dittofeed cloud we take care of hosting for you, and provide more advanced auth out of the box.

What kind of messages can I send with Dittofeed?

Messaging channels include email, sms, and webhooks, with more under active development. Send any
form of lifecycle marketing or transactional message, such as product updates, password change
alerts, newsletters, onboarding reminders, cart reminders, invoices/receipts, etc.

How do I contribute to the open-source repository?

To get involved in our development process, visit our [documentation][88] on contributing and [view
open issues][89].

How much does Dittofeed cost?

Self-hosting is free! Our cloud offering starts at $75/month. However, pricing is dependent on your
organization’s unique active user count and the number of events we will be processing on your
behalf. Contact support@dittofeed.com for a quote.

Is there a free trial available?

Yes, all new cloud accounts receive a free 14-day trial.

# Meeting global demand for diverse resources from around the world

##### New from East View

## East Asia Book Vault

East View has assembled a selection of e-books on hundreds of topics from premier scholarly
publishers in China, all hosted in the US on our Universal Database™ (UDB) platform.

**Publishers include:**
* East China Normal University Press (华东师范大学出版社)
* Higher Education Press (高等教育出版社)
* Shanghai Literature and Art Publishing House (上海文艺出版社)
* Shanghai People’s Publishing House (上海人民出版社)
* Social Sciences Academic Press (社会科学文献出版社)

Exclusively from East View, **China Research Gateway (CRG)** transforms library access to Chinese
resources by combining multiple databases into one package, supported by an accessible and
user-friendly English-language portal.

CRG presents the full spectrum of Chinese research, with comprehensive support for multiple fields
of study including STEM, social science, and humanities disciplines.

[Learn More][54]

## Uncommon Information. Extraordinary Places.

East View is dedicated to supplying uncommon information from extraordinary places, while providing
exceptional service. We offer an extensive and expanding list of offerings, including online
databases, print periodicals, books and microforms that extend across borders, languages and
ideologies in the vernacular languages of the source. Many resources are augmented by
English-language access tools and content.

## ABOUT FORWARD PATHWAY

Forward Pathway LLC is an educational consultant company established in US and dedicated to
international students’ application and transfer to US high schools and colleges. Founded in
Pennsylvania, the state rich in educational resources, Forward Pathway takes advantage of nearby
renowned universities as [University of Pennsylvania][20], [Carnegie Mellon
University][21], [University of Pittsburgh][22], [Pennsylvania State University][23] and plenty of
top US colleges in neighboring states. Now its headquarter has moved to Los Angeles. Based in LA to
serve the entire nation, relying on strong partnerships with local US universities, Forward Pathway
is aimed at being students’ personal education specialist, at the first time to update the latest
news of studying abroad.

## 7000+

U.S. colleges database for free

## 100%

Employees worldwide education background

## 200+

Cooperate partners

## MAJOR SERVICES

### College Apply Services

We provide integrated services for high school and university applications, including personal
consultation, English test tutoring, interview experience, and other related services. The
application specialists will design plans catering to the student’s own characteristics and goals,
prepare applying materials accordingly and continue to offer follow-up services after the admission

### [US Colleges Database][24]

Forward Pathway is the first company to consolidate and visualize U.S. colleges data, the database
includes general information, [colleges ranking][25], admission, scores requirement, tuition and
fees, students, degrees, campus safety information and so on. By our colleges database tools,
students can easily filter out schools that best suits them.

### Summer/Winter Camps

The camps last 2-3 weeks long when the students will take classes in US public and private high
schools to experience different teaching styles and strengthen their knowledge about American
cultural and academic environment.The programs not only include learning in classrooms, but also
have lots of extra-curricular activities including sports and touring, a unique opportunity for
international students to feel the difference of American educational.

### Emergency Transfer

As the signature service of Forward Pathway, emergency transfer services have been carried out
efficiently on account of FP’s partnership with US local schools once the student was faced with
emergency situations such as probation, suspension or dismissal. The team will respond quickly to
make emergency plans and ensure the students transferring to new school within one to three weeks
with legal student status.

## COMPANY PHILOSOPHY

Forward Pathway, by the meaning of its name, aims at offering guidance and recommendations for
international students who are willing to study abroad in US, solving problems for the current
international students in US to carry on their academic path, and providing opportunities for
potential students to further their understanding of American education through communication
programs in the local schools.

Running in the belief of student benefits and customer satisfaction in the first place, and with all
team members familiar with application process in US, Forward Pathway relies on the abundant
educational resources in partnership with local institutions to obtain the most updated and
comprehensive information in studying in US, in order to ensure that every customer receive
high-quality services.

Forward Pathway is certified by American International Recruitment Council (AIRC), comments about
Forward Pathway for AIRC please click this [link][26].

# We simplify
# the payvider experience

 

### When payers and providers come together, good things happen for everyone. For more than a
### decade, we’ve worked with health plans and hospital networks to bridge the gap by integrating
### full-stack systems, analytics, and the people that manage them.

### For Payers

From front-office engagement to back-office interoperability, enGen’s TechOps approach offers
everything payers need to drive member satisfaction, scale processes, and accelerate growth.

### For Providers

With enGen, providers can offer smart, personalized health care experiences that lead to better
outcomes for patients and clinicians. Handle scheduling, billing, virtual visits, analytics, and
more under one roof.

[enGen and predictal logo]

## Predictal™ provides flexible, automated care management
* Modular or full-platform solution for Authorization, Utilization, Case, Disease, and Appeals and
  Grievances Management
* Create 360-degree member/patient profiles for better treatment and engagement
* Build smart workflows using automated tasks, alerts, and notifications
* Coordinate communications with providers, patients, and family members

## Simplifying the payer-provider experience with interoperability.


For over a decade, we’ve partnered with health plans and hospital networks to bridge the
payer-provider gap, seamlessly integrating full-stack systems, advanced analytics, and the people
who manage them. 


Our solutions are built to integrate with other systems. From front-office member engagement to
back-office interoperability, enGen's TechOps approach provides payers with everything needed to
boost member satisfaction, scale operations efficiently, and accelerate growth through intelligent
automation and whole-person care.

## At enGen, we’re dedicated to driving innovation through strategic relationships.

We collaborate with leading innovators and creators to transform healthcare.

#

# **Accelerating Health Innovation Through Public-Private Collaboration**

Health Capital Helsinki (HCH) is an innovation alliance of the Cities of Helsinki and Espoo,
University of Helsinki, Aalto University, HUS Helsinki University Hospital and Metropolia and
Haaga-Helia Universities of Applied Sciences.

HCH’s core mission is to build joint research and innovation projects that bring together expertise
from both the public and private sectors. We unite these sectors to co-create innovative solutions
that advance health and generate shared value for both society and business in the Helsinki Capital
Region.

## Partner with Health Capital Helsinki

Health Capital Helsinki helps transform ideas into impactful health innovations faster, smarter, and
together.

[
Our collaboration model
][29]

**Connect & Catalyze**

Bring together universities, university hospitals, cities, and industry partners to identify and
launch impactful research and innovation (R&I) collaborations.

****Build & Empower****

Form strong, multi-stakeholder R&I consortiums for securing **national and EU-level funding** and
accelerate the translation of ideas into real-world solutions and societal impact.

****Showcase & Strengthen****

Promote the **joint visibility and global reach** of member organizations’ health research,
innovation projects, and related success stories.

## Alliance partners

Health Capital Helsinki (HCH) is a research and development alliance that brings together key
institutions in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area to advance health and life sciences innovation
through public private partnerships and co-creation.

[
About
][30]

Helsinki is the capital of Finland. Helsinki provides all the conditions for living the best
possible life.

Espoo is a leading innovation hub that creates the kind of innovation the world needs. Ideas flow
through our innovation community like tides, carrying the excitement of people and leading to better
quality of life.

HUS Helsinki University Hospital is the biggest health care provider in Finland. As a university
hospital, we continuously develop and evaluate our treatment methods and activities.

The University of Helsinki is the oldest and largest institution of academic education in the
country. The university is an international scientific community of 40,000 students and researchers.

Aalto University is where people who think differently bring the best out of each other. A place
where imagination and theory meet practice and reality. A community to solve challenges most
consider impossible.

Haaga-Helia is a strongly business orientated university of applied sciences. We focus on
co-operation, entrepreneurship, innovation and internationality.

Metropolia University of Applied Sciences, Finland’s largest university of applied sciences,
educates future professionals in the fields of Business, Culture, Health Care and Social Services,
and Technology.

## Transforming healthcare** through technology**

With over 30 years of experience, Altron HealthTech built a solid foundation in practice management
and electronic claims switching to revolutionise healthcare with more proactive, secure, and
intuitive technologies. We combine innovative technology with a commitment to security in regulated
industries, offering solutions like intuitive EHRs, comprehensive practice management tools,
occupational health, medical bureau services, and data-driven health insights. Whether we’re
supporting small practices or large enterprises, our goal is to make healthcare simpler, smarter,
and safer regardless of the industry, addressing real-world challenges, improving the experience for
both patients and providers alike.

Our employees are the heartbeat of our business and are top priority as we believe an empowered and
